Dragon Quest Monsters 2 - Iru to Ruka no.name: Dragon Quest Monsters 2: Iru and Luca's Marvelous Mysterious Key
Dragon Quest Monsters 2 - Iru to Ruka no.summary:
A combined remake of the two "Dragon Quest monsters 2" Game Boy color games that was only released in Japan.

The game has 3D graphics, uses a 3rd person view, and features new monsters including giant monsters and monster customization where you can use 4 monster parts to create your own monster.
